patch_description:
Redesign feature engineering to be regime-invariant:
1. Replace long lookback windows (20-60) with shorter (5-10) for faster adaptation
2. Add z-score normalization within rolling windows for volatility/trend invariance
3. Add rate-of-change features (vol_trend, efficiency_trend) instead of absolute levels
4. Simplify interactions to be normalized together
5. Increase n_estimators (to learn variance) and reduce regularization (lambda/alpha)
6. This addresses the core problem: features that mean different things across regimes.
